title: Self-Distillation is Optimal Among Spectral Shrinkage Estimators
abstract: arXiv:2605.17778v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Self-distillation has emerged as a promising technique for improving model performance in modern machine learning systems. We develop the statistical foundations of self-distillation in high-dimensional linear regression by introducing and analyzing a broad class of estimators, namely spectral shrinkage estimators. We consider both spiked and general covariance matrices. For the former, we establish that when the covariance has $s$ distinct spikes, $s$-step self-distillation achieves optimal prediction among spectral shrinkage estimators, outperforming well-known estimators in statistics and machine learning. Moreover, we show that $s$ steps are necessary for optimality: any $(s-k)$-step distilled estimator is strictly suboptimal for $1 \leq k \leq s$. translated_title: 自蒸馏在谱收缩估计器中是最优的
translated_abstract: 自蒸馏已成为提升现代机器学习系统模型性能的一种有前景的技术。我们在高维线性回归中建立了自蒸馏的统计学基础，引入并分析了一类广泛的估计器，即谱收缩估计器。我们同时考虑了尖峰协方差矩阵和一般协方差矩阵。对于前者，我们证明当协方差矩阵具有 $s$ 个不同的尖峰时，$s$ 步自蒸馏在谱收缩估计器中实现了最优预测，优于统计学和机器学习中著名的估计器。此外，我们证明 $s$ 步是达到最优性的必要条件：对于 $1 \leq k \leq s$，任何 $(s-k)$ 步的蒸馏估计器都是严格次优的。对于一般协方差矩阵，我们证明随着蒸馏步数的增加，自蒸馏逼近连续谱收缩估计器中的最优极限预测风险。
tldr: 该论文证明在高维线性回归中，当协方差矩阵具有 $s$ 个尖峰时，$s$ 步自蒸馏在谱收缩估计器类中达到最优预测，且证明 $s$ 步是实现最优性的必要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that in high-dimensional linear regression, s-step self-distillation achieves optimal prediction among spectral shrinkage estimators when the covariance has s spikes, and that s steps are necessary for optimality.
